_comment: Canonical references store for the eRUPT proposal. See references-spec.md. proposal/main.tex and citation-matrix.md are derived views and must stay in sync. Metadata sourced/confirmed via Consensus (2026-06-27) except [2] (local DOE source). existsCheck/metadataCheck = pass via that source; citationCorrectness still needs the review-agent §4A pass + team review, so verified stays false until then. Reference count (15) intentionally exceeds NFR-002 (~5-8); team to advise on cuts.
